title: Recipe import agent (no tools)
description: Foods, grams, servings and steps read from a recipe the user pasted. Prompt: prompts/import.md. Grams are for the whole recipe; code divides them by the servings (from the text, else the user is asked). The model picks foods and grams only; packs, macros and cost are code.

paste.description: The pasted recipe text, as the user pasted it.

servings.description: Only when the text states it; null otherwise.

line.description: The ingredient line as written in the paste, or the step words that name the food.

name.description: The exact known_ingredients name when the food fits one, else a plain English food name.

grams_total.description: Grams for the whole recipe as written.

units_total.description: Eggs only (size M, 51 g each); 0 for everything else.

guessed.description: True when the text gives no amount or size and the grams are the model's estimate.

dry.description: True for rice, pasta, quinoa and couscous, whose grams are dry (uncooked) weight.

pieces.description: Optional. Whole pieces the line counts (4 large potatoes, 3 cloves garlic). Code weighs foods in data/open/piece-weights.json and replaces grams_total.
